床前明月光
疑是地上霜
举头望明月
低头思故乡

In front of my bed shines the moonlight,
As if it were frost on the ground.
I raise my head to gaze at the bright moon,
And lower mine eyes to miss home.

Boundary example, unrelated to the target: 虽归未见君 -> Though I have returned, I have not seen you. Avoid I returned and saw you, which reverses the negative. Example: 隔岸灯明 -> Across the bank the lamps are bright. Do not add an unseen village or a reason for the lamps.
rows.output:
I live at the head of the Yangtze,
You reside at its tail end.
Every day I think of you but cannot see you,
We drink the same river water together.
This water will never cease flowing,
This sorrow will never be resolved.
May your heart truly love me as my heart loves you,
I promise to fulfill your deep longing.
rows.notes: 两处问句改断言，末句将我的相思改成你的渴望
